description: Trusted architecture-review artifact signers. Keys are added ONLY by the maintainer after personal vetting — an agent key here means any agent can mint APPROVED review artifacts (see issue #738 / 2026-08-29 incident). The bootstrap key koinon-bootstrap-agent-2026-07 was revoked 2026-08-29: it was used to self-sign approvals on PRs authored by the same agent. CI verifies artifacts against the origin/dev copy of this file, not the PR tree.
